title: [Mechanism of Spatholobi Caulis in inhibiting microglial activation to intervene neuropathic pain through TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling].
authors: Wu, Jing; Liang, Da-Yi; Zhang, Di; Wang, Fang-Fang; Wang, Wen-Jing; Wang, Long; Tang, Ting; Chen, Peng
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究鸡血藤通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB通路抑制小胶质细胞激活治疗神经病理性疼痛，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Based on network pharmacology and molecular docking combined with animal experimental validation, this study aims to explore the mechanism of action of Spatholobi Caulis in the treatment of neuropathic pain(NP). Ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography Q-Orbitrap high-resolution mass spectrometry(UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap HRMS) was used to identify the chemical constituents of Spatholobi Caulis, analyze the core drug-disease targets, and perform pathway enrichment and molecular docking validation. Forty-eight male Sprague Dawley(SD) rats were randomly divided into a sham group, a model group, high-dose, medium-dose, and low-dose groups of Spatholobi Caulis, and a positive control group of Pregabalin, with eight rats in each group. The NP model was established by chronic constriction injury(CCI) to the sciatic nerve of rats in all groups except the sham group in which only the sciatic nerve was exposed without ligation. Dosing was initiated after the behavioral measurements on the 5th day following modeling and was administered for 14 days. On one day before surgery, the 3rd and 5th days after CCI, and the 3rd, 7th, 11th, and 14th days after drug administration, the mechanical withdrawal threshold(MWT) and thermal withdrawal latency(TWL) of the experimental rats were measured by electronic Von Frey and a plantar test apparatus to assess changes in pain behavior. Immunohistochemistry was utilized to detect the expression of ionized calcium binding adapter molecule 1(Iba1) in spinal cord tissue. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay(ELISA) was used to detect the level of interleukin-6(IL-6), interleukin-1beta(IL-1beta), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha(TNF-alpha) in spinal cord tissue, and Western blot and immunofluorescence were used to detect the expression of Toll-like receptor 4(TLR4), myeloid differentiation primary response 88(MyD88), nuclear factor kappaB(NF-kappaB) p65, phosphorylated NF-kappaB(p-NF-kappaB) p65, IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and Iba1 proteins in spinal cord tissue. The results indicated that a total of 150 compounds were identified in the Spatholobi Caulis, including 61 flavonoids, 23 isoflavonoids, 11 organic oxides, 5 coumarins, 5 linear 1,3-diphenylpropanes, and 45 other types of compounds. Network pharmacology analysis revealed that for NP treatment with Spatholobi Caulis, epidermal growth factor receptor(EGFR), protein kinase B(AKT1), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3(STAT3), TNF, cysteine-aspartic acid protease-3(CASP3), mitogen-activated protein kinase 3(MAPK3), and TLR4 were the core targets, and the regulatory effect on the TLR signaling pathway was the key mechanism. Experimental verification results showed that compared with the sham group, the model group exhibited significantly decreased MWT and TWL(P<0.01) and significantly increased expressions of TLR4, MyD88, NF-kappaB p65, p-NF-kappaB p65, Iba1, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IL-6 proteins in spinal cord tissue(P<0.01). Compared with the model group, the high-dose group of Spatholobi Caulis displayed significantly increased MWT and TWL in NP rats(P<0.05) and down-regulated expressions of TLR4, MyD88, NF-kappaB p65, p-NF-kappaB p65, Iba1, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IL-6 proteins in spinal cord tissue(P<0.05). The molecular docking results showed that multiple components had a good affinity for TLR4 and MyD88, and buddleoside had the highest affinity for TLR4 and MyD88. In summary, Spatholobi Caulis can inhibit microglia activation and alleviate NP by modulating the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 基于网络药理学和分子对接结合动物实验验证，本研究旨在探讨鸡血藤治疗神经病理性疼痛（NP）的作用机制。采用超高效液相色谱Q-Orbitrap高分辨质谱（UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap HRMS）鉴定鸡血藤的化学成分，分析核心药物-疾病靶点，并进行通路富集和分子对接验证。将48只雄性Sprague Dawley（SD）大鼠随机分为假手术组、模型组、鸡血藤高剂量组、中剂量组、低剂量组和普瑞巴林阳性对照组，每组8只。除假手术组仅暴露坐骨神经而不结扎外，其余各组均通过慢性坐骨神经压迫损伤（CCI）建立NP模型。造模后第5天行为学测量后开始给药，连续给药14天。在术前1天、CCI后第3天和第5天，以及给药后第3天、第7天、第11天和第14天，使用电子Von Frey和足底测试仪测量实验大鼠的机械 withdrawal 阈值（MWT）和热 withdrawal 潜伏期（TWL），以评估疼痛行为变化。采用免疫组织化学检测脊髓组织中离子化钙结合适配分子1（Iba1）的表达。采用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）检测脊髓组织中白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）的水平，并采用Western blot和免疫荧光检测脊髓组织中Toll样受体4（TLR4）、髓样分化初级反应88（MyD88）、核因子κB（NF-κB）p65、磷酸化NF-κB（p-NF-κB）p65、IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α和Iba1蛋白的表达。结果表明，在鸡血藤中共鉴定出150种化合物，包括61种黄酮类、23种异黄酮类、11种有机氧化物、5种香豆素类、5种线性1,3-二苯基丙烷类，以及45种其他类型化合物。网络药理学分析显示，对于鸡血藤治疗NP，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）、蛋白激酶B（AKT1）、信号转导和转录激活因子3（STAT3）、TNF、半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-3（CASP3）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶3（MAPK3）和TLR4是核心靶点，对TLR信号通路的调节作用是关键机制。实验验证结果显示，与假手术组相比，模型组MWT和TWL显著降低（P<0.01），脊髓组织中TLR4、MyD88、NF-κB p65、p-NF-κB p65、Iba1、IL-1β、TNF-α和IL-6蛋白表达显著升高（P<0.01）。与模型组相比，鸡血藤高剂量组NP大鼠的MWT和TWL显著升高（P<0.05），脊髓组织中TLR4、MyD88、NF-κB p65、p-NF-κB p65、Iba1、IL-1β、TNF-α和IL-6蛋白表达下调（P<0.05）。分子对接结果显示，多种成分对TLR4和MyD88具有良好的亲和力，其中 buddleoside 对TLR4和MyD88的亲和力最高。综上所述，鸡血藤可通过调节TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB信号通路抑制小胶质细胞活化并缓解NP。
